gdb_commands:
set pagination off
set confirm off
set environment TERM dumb
set environment INPUTRC /dev/null
python
import gdb,struct,json
entries={0x8089e40:'model',0x8087d14:'scattering',0x804ec50:'resonance'}
for address in entries:gdb.Breakpoint('*'+hex(address),internal=True)
end
run -g -t process.tek -x input.asit < answers.txt
python
result={};pending={};model_events=[];resonance_events=[];skip_models=0
def memory(a,n):return bytes(gdb.selected_inferior().read_memory(a,n))
def u32(a):return struct.unpack('<I',memory(a,4))[0]
def ports():return [memory(a,8).hex() for a in (0x80d8da8,0x80d8db0,0x80d8db8,0x80d8dc0,0x80d8dd8,0x80d8de0,0x80d8de8,0x80d8df0)]
control_before=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$fctrl'))
while len(result)<3:
 address=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$pc'))
 if address in entries:
  kind=entries[address]
  if kind not in result:
   esp=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$esp'));pc=u32(esp)
   item=dict(kind=kind)
   if kind=='model':item.update(Y=ports(),frequency_bits=memory(esp+4,8).hex(),coordinate_heights=[memory(u32(0x80d891c)+8*i,8).hex() for i in range(u32(0x80d8904))])
   if kind=='scattering':item['Y']=ports()
   assert pc not in pending
   pending[pc]=item;gdb.Breakpoint('*'+hex(pc),temporary=True,internal=True)
 else:
  assert address in pending,(hex(address),pending)
  item=pending.pop(address);kind=item.pop('kind')
  if kind=='model':item['M']=[memory(0x80d8820+8*i,8).hex() for i in range(12)]
  if kind=='scattering':item['S']=[memory(a,8).hex() for base in (0x80d8d58,0x80d8d28,0x80d8d48,0x80d8d18) for a in (base,base+8)]
  if kind=='resonance':item['extended_bits']=bytes(gdb.parse_and_eval('$st0').bytes).hex()
  if kind=='model':
   model_events.append(item)
   if len(model_events)>skip_models:result[kind]=item
  elif kind=='resonance':
   resonance_events.append(item)
   if len(resonance_events)>skip_models:result[kind]=item
  else:result[kind]=item
 if len(result)<3:gdb.execute('continue',to_string=True)
assert not pending
result.update(control_before=control_before,control_after=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$fctrl')),model_events=model_events,resonance_events=resonance_events)
open('raw.json','w').write(json.dumps(result))
end
kill
quit
contact_gdb_commands:
set pagination off
set confirm off
set environment TERM dumb
set environment INPUTRC /dev/null
break *0x8053580
run -g -t process.tek -x input.asit < answers.txt
python
import gdb,struct,json
def memory(a,n):return bytes(gdb.selected_inferior().read_memory(a,n))
def u32(a):return struct.unpack('<I',memory(a,4))[0]
def i32(a):return struct.unpack('<i',memory(a,4))[0]
def f64(a):return struct.unpack('<d',memory(a,8))[0]
def segment(a):return dict(points=[list(struct.unpack('<3d',memory(a+k,24)))for k in(0,24,0x44,0x5c,0x88,0xa0)],width=f64(a+0xcc),primary_width=f64(a+0x30),metal=i32(a+0xdc),nx=i32(a+0xe0),ny=i32(a+0xe4))
esp=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$esp'));finish=u32(esp);shapes=[u32(esp+4),u32(esp+8)]
origins={}
for shape in shapes:
 origin=[f64(shape+0x54),f64(shape+0x5c)];s=u32(shape+0xa8)
 while s:
  origins[s]=origin;extra=u32(s+0xe8)
  while extra:origins[extra]=origin;extra=u32(extra+0xe8)
  s=u32(s+0xec)
options=dict(nx=i32(0x80ce990),ny=i32(0x80ce994),width=f64(0x80ce980),height=f64(0x80ce988),length_step=f64(0x80ce598),width_step=f64(0x80ce5a0),metal_count=i32(0x80d8904))
before=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$fctrl'));records=[];pending={};build=0x8053a1c
gdb.Breakpoint('*'+hex(build),internal=True);gdb.Breakpoint('*'+hex(finish),temporary=True,internal=True)
gdb.execute('continue',to_string=True)
while int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$pc'))!=finish:
 pc=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$pc'))
 if pc==build:
  esp=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$esp'));ret=u32(esp);group=u32(esp+4);s=u32(esp+8);old=u32(group+128)
  assert s in origins and ret not in pending
  item=dict(segment=segment(s),origin=origins[s],counts=[i32(group+112),i32(group+116)],translated=[f64(group+k)for k in(80,88,96,104)])
  pending[ret]=(group,old,item);gdb.Breakpoint('*'+hex(ret),temporary=True,internal=True)
 else:
  assert pc in pending,(hex(pc),pending)
  group,old,item=pending.pop(pc);contact=u32(group+128);contacts=[]
  while contact!=old:
   assert contact and len(contacts)<1024
   contacts.append(dict(bounds_bits=memory(contact,32).hex(),indices=list(struct.unpack('<5i',memory(contact+32,20)))))
   contact=u32(contact+56)
  item['contacts']=contacts;records.append(item)
 gdb.execute('continue',to_string=True)
assert not pending
result=dict(options=options,records=records,success=bool(int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$eax'))&255),control_before=before,control_after=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$fctrl')))
open('contacts.json','w').write(json.dumps(result))
end
kill
quit

Interactive angle values retain the actual native raw-radian prompt behavior. Both original nonfinite histories retain all raw outputs, direct CLI transcripts and independently captured contact bounds; one has zero contact area, while the finer-grid case has nonzero contact area.
